subject: Create Litestream config replicating state.db and dbos.db
description:
Write `scripts/litestream.yml` replicating `state.db` and `dbos.db` to a local folder + a private cloud bucket. Document paired-restore commands so the two files are always restored from the same backup point.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Litestream YAML covers both `state.db` and `dbos.db`.
- [ ] At least two replicas per DB: one local (e.g. `~/Backups/capo`) and one cloud (e.g. S3).
- [ ] Documented restore command pair restores BOTH files from the SAME timestamp/snapshot.
- [ ] Runbook entry (separate task) references this config.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Cloud bucket creds rotated: documented in runbook; restart Litestream sibling job.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Litestream can't write to a replica target: retries with backoff; operator alert on persistent failure.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: restore exercise: restore paired `state.db` + `dbos.db` from the same backup point; full Phase 1–5 integration tests still pass (anchors §9.5 checkpoint row + §11.1 rollback)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 9.5, 11.1, 11.4, 13
